userStories.title: Characterize pending-row node projection for mixed rows and sibling nodes
userStories.description: As a workflow observer, I want the node state projector to project awaiting accurately when multiple Ask rows exist, so that a node stays awaiting while any of its rows is pending and sibling nodes without pending rows remain unaffected.
acceptanceCriteria: Append same-node mixed-row characterization test to packages/workflows/src/retry-state.test.ts verifying projectLatestEffectiveNodeStates keeps a node awaiting when one row is answered and another is pending without requiring a node_awaiting event.

Append sibling-ownership characterization test to packages/workflows/src/retry-state.test.ts verifying projectLatestEffectiveNodeStates overlays awaiting only onto the sibling node that owns a pending Ask row, while the other sibling with answered rows remains running.
Focused test cd packages/workflows && bun test src/retry-state.test.ts passes with all projector tests green.

userStories.title: Characterize run-wide Ask resolution, multi-kind blockers, and run ownership in SQLite
userStories.description: As a database layer consumer, I want resolvePendingInteraction in real SQLite to track run-wide pending counts and enforce run-id ownership, so that the workflow run resumes only when the very last pending row of any kind is answered and child asks cannot be resolved via parent runs.
acceptanceCriteria: Import PendingInteractionNotFoundError into packages/core/src/db/workflow-pending-interactions.test.ts destructured import.

Add test 'keeps two Ask nodes blocked until the last run-wide pending row is answered' asserting first answer returns resumed: false, remaining_pending: 1, run status 'paused', and second answer returns resumed: true, remaining_pending: 0, run status 'running'.
Add test 'counts a pending permission interaction when an Ask answer is resolved' proving resolvePendingInteraction counts pending rows of kind 'permission' and does not resume the run.

Add test 'resolves a child Ask only through the child workflow run id' proving resolving with parent workflow_run_id throws PendingInteractionNotFoundError, child row remains pending, and resolving with child run id resumes child without mutating parent run status.
Focused test cd packages/core && bun test src/db/workflow-pending-interactions.test.ts passes in its own process.
Changes are committed cleanly with commit message 'test(core): cover run-wide ask resolution'.

userStories.title: Characterize concurrent DAG Ask scheduling and update executor comments
userStories.description: As a workflow executor maintainer, I want DAG scheduling to handle multiple concurrent Ask invocations, in-flight streaming siblings, and repeated Asks from one node without scheduling deadlocks, so that the run pauses safely while letting already-started sibling streams finish.
acceptanceCriteria: Generalize Ask test helpers in packages/workflows/src/dag-executor.test.ts: implement deferred(), wireAskPause(store, onPause) asserting pauseWorkflowRun is called without approval context and throws if run is not running/paused, invokeInjectedAskHuman(options, toolUseId, sessionId), and executeAskDag(store, workflowRun, nodes).

Add test 'persists a second sibling Ask after the first Ask has paused the run' proving both Ask rows are inserted, pauseWorkflowRun is called twice with the run id, mockSendQueryDag is called twice, and no node_completed events are emitted for the asking nodes.

Add test 'lets an already-started sibling finish streaming after another node pauses the run' proving the sibling yields assistant text and result after the first pause, beta messages record text and completed status, exactly one node_completed event is stored, and downstream layers do not start.

Add test 'persists two Ask calls from one node before unwinding it as awaiting' using Promise.allSettled in fake provider, proving two tool use ids are inserted, pauseWorkflowRun is called twice, and review node records status awaiting without completed or failed.

Update stale comments in packages/workflows/src/dag-executor.ts in shouldContinueStreamingForStatus, executeNodeInternal, and loop-node event loop to clarify that concurrent approval or AskHuman nodes can transition the run.
Focused test cd packages/workflows && bun test src/dag-executor.test.ts passes.
Changes are committed cleanly with commit message 'test(workflows): cover concurrent ask scheduling'.
